title: Student ink in digital assessment
notes: 0:00–0:30. Explain the educational goal. This is a real user-supplied physical-paper photo new to the local acceptance benchmark. No general recognition-accuracy claim.

title: The assisted workflow
notes: 0:30–0:55. The person supplies calibration and the trace. The system maps and stores geometry. The separate dot uses the existing native point tool after import.

title: A real-photo assisted demonstration
notes: 0:55–2:45. Follow PRESENTER.md. Show the photo review and import, manually retain the dot, Save & Grade, native whole-branch edit and refresh. A prepared variant or recorded backup is available if the live interaction takes too long.

title: Measured geometry preservation
notes: 2:45–3:15. Values come from results/evaluation.json. Native controls preserve traced vertices to numerical precision. Manual source tracing is approximate and has a 0.75px simplification tolerance. Do not equate encoding fidelity with automatic extraction.

title: Automatic and manual responsibilities
notes: 3:15–3:45. Corrections use whole-branch movement or delete/retrace. Unsaved photo markup does not survive refresh. Numeric calibration has no independent survey ground truth.

title: Reliability and future research
notes: 3:45–4:15, with up to45seconds spare. Future VLM research must preserve actual ink and uncertainty, then compare against source geometry before integration. Do not imply Gemini has been tested. Timing is a planned presenter allocation, not measured human performance.
